Game Overview

In Miles Tails Prower, the core idea is straightforward: guide Tails through intricate levels with strategic drag-and-drop mechanics in this engaging puzzle adventure. Craft paths, navigate obstacles, and solve complex puzzles, all while immersing yourself in the nostalgic Sonic universe. Quick thinking and creative solutions are key as challenges intensify, promising endless fun and strategic delight.
